decisionContext: The owner had just been told the next step was to ship the 48 newly approved North Node passages into the governed Calendar exact-aspect corpus, then replied "yes please continue".
summary: A strict rule or a firm deadline may provide the exact structure an unfamiliar plan needs to survive.
body: A strict rule or a firm deadline may provide the exact structure an unfamiliar plan needs to survive. When Saturn sextiles the North Node, formal boundaries can give a new ambition enough structure to become workable. You do not need to view every limitation as a roadblock designed to stop you. Accept the commitment, schedule, or budget that gives your next move enough protection to hold up in ordinary life.
